0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 1-5 on the road, 13th in the East) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (4-6, 3-3 at home, 11th in the West) in the Nets' 11th game of the season, and both teams have lost their last two. Brooklyn will be without Egor Demin (leg bruise), while Mikel Brown Jr. is day-to-day with rest and a game-time decision after averaging 12.9 points in 23.2 minutes per game. New Orleans is missing Trendon Watford (ankle), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis), Yves Missi (knee bruise) and Zion Williamson (rest). The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Nets' last meeting was a 116-113 loss in New Orleans on January 14, 2026, while this season's series has no games yet.
